Frame positions: Some areas do not have a frame placed on the plan yet. Orange dashed frames in the top-left are temporary placeholders (not real positions). Press Draw Area Mode and drag a frame over the real area on the image. Frames can be tilted or rotated. Numbers and charts work without frames (click the area chips below the plan).
The plan image could not be loaded automatically in this view (the viewer may block files attached to the chat). Press Choose Plan Image and select LSPE.png from your computer. Frames are stored as fractions of the image, so they fit any image size. The PowerPoint and HTML exports also need this file: if you press Export PowerPoint or Export HTML first, the file chooser opens by itself.
